title: षड्विंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Lomasha tells how King Yuvanashva, childless, drank by mistake the consecrated water meant for his queen and himself conceived. The child Mandhatar was born from his side, was nursed on Indra's finger, and became a great emperor who performed many sacrifices.
summary.kn: ಸಂತಾನಹೀನ ಯುವನಾಶ್ವರಾಜನು ರಾಣಿಗಾಗಿ ಮಂತ್ರಿಸಿದ ನೀರನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಾಗಿ ಕುಡಿದು ತಾನೇ ಗರ್ಭಧರಿಸಿದ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಲೋಮಶರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವನ ಪಾರ್ಶ್ವದಿಂದ ಜನಿಸಿದ ಮಾಂಧಾತನು ಇಂದ್ರನ ಬೆರಳನ್ನು ಚೀಪಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ಅನೇಕ ಯಜ್ಞಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿದ ಮಹಾಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿಯಾದನು.
summary.hi: लोमश बताते हैं कि निःसन्तान राजा युवनाश्व ने भूल से रानी के लिए अभिमन्त्रित जल पी लिया और स्वयं गर्भवती हो गए। उनकी बगल से जन्मा बालक मान्धाता इन्द्र की उँगली चूसकर पला और अनेक यज्ञ करने वाला महान सम्राट बना।
summary.te: సంతానం లేని యువనాశ్వరాజు రాణి కోసం మంత్రించిన నీటిని పొరపాటున తాగి తానే గర్భం ధరించిన కథను లోమశుడు చెబుతాడు. అతని పార్శ్వం నుండి జన్మించిన మాంధాత ఇంద్రుని వేలు చప్పరిస్తూ పెరిగి అనేక యజ్ఞాలు చేసిన మహాచక్రవర్తి అయ్యాడు.
summary.ta: மக்கட்பேறற்ற யுவநாஶ்வ மன்னன் அரசிக்காக மந்திரித்த நீரைத் தவறாகக் குடித்துத் தானே கருவுற்ற கதையை லோமஶர் சொல்கிறார். அவன் விலாவிலிருந்து பிறந்த மாந்தாதா இந்திரனின் விரலைச் சுவைத்து வளர்ந்து பல யாகங்கள் செய்த பேரரசனானான்.
summary.ml: സന്താനമില്ലാത്ത യുവനാശ്വൻ രാജാവ്, രാജ്ഞിക്കായി തയ്യാറാക്കിയ മന്ത്രജലം തെറ്റി കുടിക്കുന്നു; അങ്ങനെ അദ്ദേഹം ഗർഭം ധരിക്കുന്നു. അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ വശത്തുനിന്ന് ജനിച്ച കുട്ടി മാന്ധാതാവ് ഇന്ദ്രന്റെ വിരൽ നുണഞ്ഞ് വളർന്നു, ധാരാളം യാഗങ്ങൾ ചെയ്ത മഹാചക്രവർത്തിയായി.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.126; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
मान्धाता राजशार्दूलस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः ।
कथं जातो महाब्रह्मन्यौवनाश्वो नृपोत्तमः ।
कथं चैतां परां काष्ठां प्राप्तवानमितद्युतिः ॥

meaning.en: Great brahmin, how was Mandhata, the tiger among kings, famed in the three worlds, born, that best of kings, the son of Yuvanashva? And how did that man of boundless splendour reach such a pinnacle?

verses.text:
यस्य लोकास्त्रयो वश्या विष्णोरिव महात्मनः ।
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं चरितं तस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: The three worlds were subject to him as to the great Vishnu. I wish to hear the story of that wise king.

verses.text:
यथा मान्धातृशब्दश्च तस्य शक्रसमद्युतेः ।
जन्म चाप्रतिवीर्यस्य कुशलो ह्यसि भाषितुम् ॥

meaning.en: You are skilled in telling it: how that king, as radiant as Indra and of unmatched might, got the name Mandhata, and how he was born.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
शृणुष्वावहितो राजन्राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः ।
यथा मान्धातृशब्दो वै लोकेषु परिगीयते ॥

meaning.en: Listen with attention, king, to how the name Mandhata came to be sung in the worlds for that great-souled king.

verses.text:
इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो युवनाश्वो महीपतिः ।
सोऽयजत्पृथिवीपाल क्रतुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः ॥

meaning.en: Yuvanashva, born in the Ikshvaku line, was a lord of the earth who performed sacrifices with large fees.

verses.text:
अश्वमेधसहस्रं च प्राप्य धर्मभृतां वरः ।
अन्यैश्च क्रतुभिर्मुख्यैर्विविधैराप्तदक्षिणैः ॥

meaning.en: That best of dharma's upholders performed a thousand horse sacrifices and many other chief sacrifices of different kinds, with full fees paid.

verses.text:
अनपत्यस्तु राजर्षिः स महात्मा दृढव्रतः ।
मन्त्रिष्वाधाय तद्राज्यं वननित्यो बभूव ह ॥

meaning.en: But that great-souled royal sage of firm vows had no child. He entrusted his kingdom to his ministers and took up a life in the forest.

verses.text:
शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना संयोज्यात्मानमात्मना ।
पिपासाशुष्कहृदयः प्रविवेशाश्रमं भृगोः ॥

meaning.en: Disciplining himself by himself according to the rule of the scriptures, with his heart dry from thirst, he entered the hermitage of Bhrigu.

verses.text:
तामेव रात्रिं राजेन्द्र महात्मा भृगुनन्दनः ।
इष्टिं चकार सौद्युम्नेर्महर्षिः पुत्रकारणात् ॥

meaning.en: On that very night, king, the great-souled son of Bhrigu was performing a rite for the son of Sudyumna, for the sake of a son.

verses.text:
संभृतो मन्त्रपूतेन वारिणा कलशो महान् ।
तत्रातिष्ठत राजेन्द्र पूर्वमेव समाहितः ।
यत्प्राश्य प्रसवेत्तस्य पत्नी शक्रसमं सुतम् ॥

meaning.en: A great pot had been filled with water purified by mantras, and it had been set there beforehand with care. By drinking it, his wife would bear a son like Indra.

verses.text:
तं न्यस्य वेद्यां कलशं सुषुपुस्ते महर्षयः ।
रात्रिजागरणश्रान्ताः सौद्युम्निः समतीत्य तान् ॥

meaning.en: The great seers placed the pot on the altar and went to sleep, wearied from keeping vigil all night. Passing them, the son of Sudyumna came in.

verses.text:
शुष्ककण्ठः पिपासार्तः पानीयार्थी भृशं नृपः ।
तं प्रविश्याश्रमं श्रान्तः पानीयं सोऽभ्ययाचत ॥

meaning.en: His throat dry, tormented by thirst, the king was desperate for water. Tired, he entered the hermitage and asked for water.

verses.text:
तस्य श्रान्तस्य शुष्केण कण्ठेन क्रोशतस्तदा ।
नाश्रौषीत्कश्चन तदा शकुनेरिव वाशितम् ॥

meaning.en: As he cried out in his weariness with a parched throat, no one heard him, any more than the chirp of a bird.

verses.text:
ततस्तं कलशं दृष्ट्वा जलपूर्णं स पार्थिवः ।
अभ्यद्रवत वेगेन पीत्वा चाम्भो व्यवासृजत् ॥

meaning.en: Then the king saw that pot full of water and hurried to it, and he drank the water and put down the pot.

verses.text:
स पीत्वा शीतलं तोयं पिपासार्तो महीपतिः ।
निर्वाणमगमद्धीमान्सुसुखी चाभवत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: The wise king, tormented by thirst, drank that cool water and was refreshed, and felt very comfortable.

verses.text:
ततस्ते प्रत्यबुध्यन्त ऋषयः सनराधिपाः ।
निस्तोयं तं च कलशं ददृशुः सर्व एव ते ॥

meaning.en: Then the seers woke, and the lord of men, and they all saw that the pot was empty of water.

verses.text:
कस्य कर्मेदमिति च पर्यपृच्छन्समागताः ।
युवनाश्वो मयेत्येव सत्यं समभिपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: Gathered together they asked, "Whose doing is this?" And Yuvanashva admitted the truth: "It was I."

verses.text:
न युक्तमिति तं प्राह भगवान्भार्गवस्तदा ।
सुतार्थं स्थापिता ह्यापस्तपसा चैव संभृताः ॥

meaning.en: The holy Bhargava said to him, "This was not right. That water was set aside for a son and charged with my austerity."

verses.text:
मया ह्यत्राहितं ब्रह्म तप आस्थाय दारुणम् ।
पुत्रार्थं तव राजर्षे महाबलपराक्रम ॥

meaning.en: "By taking up fierce austerity, I had placed Brahman in it for your sake, royal sage, for a son of great strength and prowess,"

verses.text:
महाबलो महावीर्यस्तपोबलसमन्वितः ।
यः शक्रमपि वीर्येण गमयेद्यमसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: "a son of great strength and valour, endowed with the power of austerity, who could by his might send even Indra to Yama's house."

verses.text:
अनेन विधिना राजन्मयैतदुपपादितम् ।
अब्भक्षणं त्वया राजन्नयुक्तं कृतमद्य वै ॥

meaning.en: "I had arranged all this by this rite, king. Your drinking the water today was improper."

verses.text:
न त्वद्य शक्यमस्माभिरेतत्कर्तुमतोऽन्यथा ।
नूनं दैवकृतं ह्येतद्यदेवं कृतवानसि ॥

meaning.en: "We cannot now do this otherwise. Surely this was ordained by fate, since you did as you did."

verses.text:
पिपासितेन याः पीता विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृताः ।
आपस्त्वया महाराज मत्तपोवीर्यसंभृताः ।
ताभ्यस्त्वमात्मना पुत्रमेवंवीर्यं जनिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "The water you drank in your thirst, great king, was prepared with the proper rite and mantras and filled with the power of my austerity. From that water you yourself will bear a son of such power."

verses.text:
विधास्यामो वयं तत्र तवेष्टिं परमाद्भुताम् ।
यथा शक्रसमं पुत्रं जनयिष्यसि वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: "We shall perform a most wonderful rite for you there, so that you, a man of valour, will bring forth a son equal to Indra."

verses.text:
ततो वर्षशते पूर्णे तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः ।
वामं पार्श्वं विनिर्भिद्य सुतः सूर्य इवापरः ॥

meaning.en: Then, when a hundred years were complete, the son, like a second sun, split open the left side of that great-souled king and came forth.

verses.text:
निश्चक्राम महातेजा न च तं मृत्युराविशत् ।
युवनाश्वं नरपतिं तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: The child of great radiance came out, and death did not enter the king. It was a marvel in the case of King Yuvanashva.

verses.text:
ततः शक्रो महातेजास्तं दिदृक्षुरुपागमत् ।
प्रदेशिनीं ततोऽस्यास्ये शक्रः समभिसंदधे ॥

meaning.en: Then mighty Indra came, wishing to see him, and put his forefinger into the baby's mouth.

verses.text:
मामयं धास्यतीत्येवं परिभाष्टः स वज्रिणा ।
मान्धातेति च नामास्य चक्रुः सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: "This child will suck me," said the wielder of the thunderbolt, and so the gods with Indra named him Mandhata.

verses.text:
प्रदेशिनीं शक्रदत्तामास्वाद्य स शिशुस्तदा ।
अवर्धत महीपाल किष्कूणां च त्रयोदश ॥

meaning.en: Tasting the forefinger given by Indra, the child grew, king, by thirteen cubits.

verses.text:
वेदास्तं सधनुर्वेदा दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि चेश्वरम् ।
उपतस्थुर्महाराज ध्यातमात्राणि सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: The Vedas with the science of archery, and all the divine weapons, came to that lord at the mere thought of them, great king.

verses.text:
धनुराजगवं नाम शराः शृङ्गोद्भवाश्च ये ।
अभेद्यं कवचं चैव सद्यस्तमुपसंश्रयन् ॥

meaning.en: The bow called Ajagava, the arrows born of horn, and an impenetrable armour all came to him at once.

verses.text:
सोऽभिषिक्तो मघवता स्वयं शक्रेण भारत ।
धर्मेण व्यजयल्लोकांस्त्रीन्विष्णुरिव विक्रमैः ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, Indra himself, Maghavan, consecrated him. By dharma and by his valour he conquered the three worlds, like Vishnu.

verses.text:
तस्याप्रतिहतं चक्रं प्रावर्तत महात्मनः ।
रत्नानि चैव राजर्षिं स्वयमेवोपतस्थिरे ॥

meaning.en: The unobstructed wheel of that great-souled king rolled onward, and jewels came to the royal sage of their own accord.

verses.text:
तस्येयं वसुसंपूर्णा वसुधा वसुधाधिप ।
तेनेष्टं विविधैर्यज्ञैर्बहुभिः स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the earth, this earth full of wealth was his. He sacrificed with many sacrifices of various kinds, with full fees.

verses.text:
चितचैत्यो महातेजा धर्मं प्राप्य च पुष्कलम् ।
शक्रस्यार्धासनं राजँल्लब्धवानमितद्युतिः ॥

meaning.en: That greatly radiant king, having raised many shrines and gained great merit, of boundless brilliance, won half of Indra's seat.

verses.text:
एकाह्ना पृथिवी तेन धर्मनित्येन धीमता ।
निर्जिता शासनादेव सरत्नाकरपत्तना ॥

meaning.en: In a single day the wise king, ever devoted to dharma, conquered the earth with its mines and cities by his command alone.

verses.text:
तस्य चित्यैर्महाराज क्रतूनां दक्षिणावताम् ।
चतुरन्ता मही व्याप्ता नासीत्किंचिदनावृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Great king, with the shrines of his sacrifices with generous fees the earth to its four ends was covered, and nothing was left unmarked.

verses.text:
तेन पद्मसहस्राणि गवां दश महात्मना ।
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो महाराज दत्तानीति प्रचक्षते ॥

meaning.en: They say, great king, that this great-souled man gave ten thousand times a hundred thousand cows to brahmins.

verses.text:
तेन द्वादशवार्षिक्यामनावृष्ट्यां महात्मना ।
वृष्टं सस्यविवृद्ध्यर्थं मिषतो वज्रपाणिनः ॥

meaning.en: In a twelve-year drought, that great-souled man made it rain for the growth of crops, before the eyes of the thunderbolt-wielder.

verses.text:
तेन सोमकुलोत्पन्नो गान्धाराधिपतिर्महान् ।
गर्जन्निव महामेघः प्रमथ्य निहतः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: He crushed and killed with arrows the great king of Gandhara, born in the line of Soma, who roared like a huge cloud.

verses.text:
प्रजाश्चतुर्विधास्तेन जिता राजन्महात्मना ।
तेनात्मतपसा लोकाः स्थापिताश्चापि तेजसा ॥

meaning.en: Lord, that great-souled man conquered the four kinds of creatures, and by his own austerity and brilliance set the worlds in order.

verses.text:
तस्यैतद्देवयजनं स्थानमादित्यवर्चसः ।
पश्य पुण्यतमे देशे कुरुक्षेत्रस्य मध्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Here is his sacrificial ground, of sun-like radiance, in the most sacred region in the middle of Kurukshetra. Look at it.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं मान्धातुश्चरितं महत् ।
जन्म चाग्र्यं महीपाल यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: I have told you all this about Mandhata's great deeds and his supreme birth, which you asked me about, lord of the earth.
